import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import io

# Load the dataset
data = """
survived,pclass,sex,age,sibsp,parch,fare,embarked,class,who,adult_male,deck,embark_town,alive,alone
0,3,male,22.0,1,0,7.25,S,Third,man,True,,Southampton,no,False
1,1,female,38.0,1,0,71.2833,C,First,woman,False,C,Cherbourg,yes,False
1,3,female,26.0,0,0,7.925,S,Third,woman,False,,Southampton,yes,True
1,1,female,35.0,1,0,53.1,S,First,woman,False,C,Southampton,yes,False
0,3,male,35.0,0,0,8.05,S,Third,man,True,,Southampton,no,True
"""

df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(data))

# Convert categorical variables to numerical
df['sex'] = df['sex'].map({'male': 1, 'female': 0})
df['class'] = df['class'].map({'Third': 1, 'First': 2})
df['who'] = df['who'].map({'man': 1, 'woman': 0})
df['alive'] = df['alive'].map({'yes': 1, 'no': 0})

# Create a visualization
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.barplot(x='class', y='fare', hue='alive', data=df)
plt.title('Fare by Class and Survival')
